name: Elder Care
description: Coordinate care for a loved one: a visit rotation, shared care tasks, appointment notes, and an observation log the whole care circle can see.

visits.sql: SELECT * FROM app_elder_care__visits ORDER BY date ASC, time ASC

tasks.sql: SELECT * FROM app_elder_care__tasks ORDER BY (status = 'done'), (due_date = ''), due_date ASC, created_at DESC

appointments.sql: SELECT * FROM app_elder_care__appointments ORDER BY date ASC, time ASC

observations.sql: SELECT * FROM app_elder_care__observations ORDER BY observed_at DESC

add_task.title: Add a care task
add_task.description: File a task for the care circle when another app records something that needs following up — a prescription to collect, a form to return, a follow-up after an appointment.

suggested_automations.title: File a care task when an appointment goes on the calendar
suggested_automations.description: An appointment usually carries a chore with it — confirm the ride, collect the paperwork. The task lands unassigned so whoever picks it up claims it themselves rather than being volunteered by a rule.

detail.value: Follow up before this date — confirm transport and paperwork.

source.query: SELECT id AS id, title AS title, CASE WHEN time = '' THEN date ELSE date || 'T' || time END AS when_at, NULLIF(provider, '') AS subtitle, NULLIF(accompanied_by_id, '') AS member_id FROM app_elder_care__appointments WHERE date = :today ORDER BY time LIMIT 20

SELECT id AS id, title AS title, due_date AS when_at, (status = 'done') AS done, NULLIF(detail, '') AS subtitle, NULLIF(assignee_id, '') AS member_id FROM app_elder_care__tasks WHERE due_date = :today ORDER BY status, created_at LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM app_elder_care__tasks WHERE status = 'open' LIMIT 1
